parameters.query:
select coalesce(
  json_agg(json_build_object(
    'contactId', c.id,
    'firstName', c.first_name,
    'lastName', c.last_name,
    'email', c.email,
    'phone', c.phone,
    'title', c.title,
    'interactionNotes', c.interaction_notes
  ) order by c.created_at desc), '[]'::json
) as candidates
from public.contacts c
join public.inbound_messages m on m.id = c.source_message_id
where c.event_id = $1
  and c.source in ('card_photo', 'directory_photo')
  and m.from_phone = $2;

parameters.content:
## Relink unlinked audio (retry sweep)
Claim-based replacement for what the master plan originally called the transcription pipeline's "orphan-sweep" (a time-windowed design that turned out to be exactly the bug class the 2026-09-22 voice-memo audit fixed -- see the plan's "Upstream changes" section). claim_unlinked_audio_messages(50, 20, 3) mirrors agent.mjs's own LINK_MAX_ATTEMPTS/LINK_RETRY_DELAY_MINUTES/LINK_CLAIM_LIMIT defaults exactly.

Fetch Candidate Contacts mirrors findCandidateContacts() in agent.mjs: same event, source in (card_photo, directory_photo), joined through source_message_id -> inbound_messages.from_phone as the same-rep proxy -- both sources, never just card_photo. Rebuilt (Stage 3) to use a json_agg(...) aggregate rather than a plain multi-row SELECT: up to 3 messages can be claimed at once, and a plain SELECT's output rows would not stay correctly paired per claimed message once mixed together as flat items -- json_agg guarantees exactly one output row (with candidates as a possibly-empty array) per input item, preserving 1:1 pairing with Claim Unlinked Audio Messages even when a given message has zero candidates.

Link Transcript To Contacts (Stage 3, completing this workflow) calls sub-link-transcript-to-contacts once per claimed message (mode=each) with {messageId, transcript, candidates} -- transcript comes from the ORIGINAL claim row (already transcribed in a prior pass; this sweep only retries linking, never re-transcribes). This is the exact same shared sub-workflow pipeline-voice-transcription's first pass calls, matching agent.mjs's own factoring: linkTranscriptToContacts + recordLinkResult are used by both processAudioMessage and relinkUnlinkedAudioMessages. No fast path, ever -- sub-link-transcript-to-contacts always invokes sub-attribute-voice-memo whenever candidates.length > 0.

INACTIVE / BUILD-ONLY (n8n migration Stage 0/3). No credential is actually attached -- n8n instance has zero credentials configured, see n8n/README.md.

value.candidates: ={{ $json.candidates.map(c => ({ contactId: c.contactId, firstName: c.firstName, lastName: c.lastName, email: c.email, phone: c.phone, title: c.title, interactionNotes: c.interactionNotes })) }}
